label: Football

criteria.label: Kicking leg extension
criteria.look_for: kicking leg extends through the ball, ankle locked
criteria.drill: Slow-motion strikes against a wall: lock the ankle, finish toward the target.

criteria.label: Body lean over the ball
criteria.look_for: slight forward lean, head over the ball
criteria.drill: Strike low driven balls and keep the chest over the ball.

criteria.label: Hip position
criteria.look_for: hips open through contact, not collapsing
criteria.drill: Hip rotation drills with a band before striking.

camera_angles.label: Side view
camera_angles.description: Camera at 90 degrees to the action. Best for arm extension and lean.

camera_angles.label: Front view
camera_angles.description: Camera facing the athlete. Best for balance and knee alignment.

coaching_note: Judge the strike: approach, plant foot, contact, follow-through.
